gloss: means of support; connection; link; something to rely on; memento; keepsake; reminder (of a person or time)

definitions.gloss: means of support; connection; link; something to rely on
memento; keepsake; reminder (of a person or time)

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}が{心|こころ}のよすがだった。
examples.english: My friend was my emotional support.

examples.japanese: {生|い}きるよすがを{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: I lost my reason for living.

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}だけが{孤独|こどく}な{日々|ひび}のよすがだった。
examples.english: Music alone was my solace during lonely days.

examples.japanese: {亡|な}き{母|はは}のよすがの{品|しな}。
examples.english: A memento of my late mother.

examples.japanese: この{手紙|てがみ}は{青春|せいしゅん}{時代|じだい}のよすがである。
examples.english: This letter is a keepsake from my youth.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{写真|しゃしん}を{眺|なが}めて、{過|す}ぎ{去|さ}った{日々|ひび}のよすがとした。
examples.english: I gazed at old photographs, using them as a connection to days gone by.

notes:
An elegant, somewhat literary word with deep emotional resonance. Can be written in kanji as {縁|よすが} or {便|よすが}, but is most commonly written in hiragana. Appears frequently in literature, poetry, and formal or reflective writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心|こころ}のよすが: emotional support, something for the heart to cling to
- {生|い}きるよすが: reason for living, something to live for
- よすがとする: to take as one's support or keepsake
- よすがの{品|しな}: a memento, keepsake item

USAGE:
Used when speaking of something deeply important that provides emotional support, comfort, or connection — whether to a person, to the past, or to hope. Carries a poetic, often bittersweet nuance. Uncommon in casual speech but valued in literary and formal contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頼|たよ}り: reliance, support — more everyday and practical
- {縁|えん}: connection, fate — broader concept of karmic or social ties
- {形見|かたみ}: keepsake of a deceased person — specifically a memento left by someone who has died
